import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0]) * 2
    dp0 = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
    dp1 = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]

    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        for h in range(0, i + 1):
            if (i - h) % 2 != 0:
                continue
            if h + 1 <= i - 1:
                dp0[i][h] = (dp1[i - 1][h + 1] + 1) % MOD
                dp1[i][h] = dp0[i - 1][h + 1]
                if h > 0:
                    dp0[i][h] = (dp0[i][h] + dp0[i - 1][h - 1]) % MOD
                    dp1[i][h] = (dp1[i][h] + dp0[i - 1][h - 1]) % MOD
            else:
                dp0[i][h] = (dp1[i - 1][h - 1] + 1) % MOD
                dp1[i][h] = dp0[i - 1][h - 1]

    print(dp0[n][0])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
